correctness.rationale: Direct 729-choice radius enumeration is complete for K_{3,3}. Permutation and class-swap symmetry reduces to 55 canonical patterns. Exact Fraction-arithmetic Sylvester minors for the 54 nonexceptional Gram matrices at 39/25 are all positive; independent raw 729 checks agree. The exceptional operator has 2x2 block characteristic equation 16z^2-26z+1 and strictly dominant top eigenvalue (13+3sqrt(17))/16, with uniquely positive two-level eigenvector and strict ball activity. The balanced-biclique lower bound and monotone limit follow analytically from the class-constant 2x2 action. No finite experiment is extrapolated to a full all-r norm claim.

value.rationale: The smallest cubic bipartite graph is a canonical next geometry beyond complete graphs, stars, and cycles; the exact strong Hilbert constant and complete equality set are nontrivial because all three ball radii compete. The symmetry-reduced 55-case rational proof gives a reusable comparison framework, while the strictly increasing all-balanced-order lower law reveals a qualitative amplification envelope tending to sqrt(2). Exact evaluation and extremizer structure for this natural graph supply information not implied by prior graph families.
